title: Geckoboard alternatives (2026): 8 KPI dashboard tools compared on TV screens, refresh speed, alerts, and price
summary: Databox, Plecto, Klipfolio, Metabase, Grafana, Data Studio, Power BI, and Basedash compared as Geckoboard alternatives on TV mode, refresh, alerts, and price.
body_markdown:
The closest Geckoboard alternatives in 2026 are Databox for SaaS-app KPIs with a free plan and built-in anomaly alerts, Plecto for sales and support wallboards with native TV apps and one-minute SQL updates, and Klipfolio for teams that want a metric catalog or a classic TV slideshow. Metabase and Grafana suit teams that want to put live database queries on an office screen at low cost, Data Studio and Power BI suit Google and Microsoft shops, and Basedash suits teams that want an AI data analyst to build and monitor dashboards on their own database. Every price below was checked on the vendor’s official page on October 11, 2026.


## Why teams look for a Geckoboard alternative


Geckoboard does one job well: it puts a small set of live numbers on a TV or in Slack with very little setup. Teams usually start looking elsewhere for one of these reasons:


- **Dashboard and editor limits.**[Essentials](https://www.geckoboard.com/pricing/) includes 2 dashboards, 1 editor, and 1 screen. Extra dashboards cost $24 each and extra editors $20 each per month on annual billing.
- **Alerts sit on the higher plan.** Threshold alerts to Slack or Microsoft Teams start on Performance ($319 per month billed annually). Essentials has scheduled snapshots only.
- **Limited database reach.** The[Databases data source](https://support.geckoboard.com/en/articles/6055503-connect-your-sql-database-to-geckoboard-using-databases) covers MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, Redshift, Snowflake, and SQL Server. BigQuery data has to go through[Google Sheets](https://support.geckoboard.com/en/articles/6577410-import-bigquery-data-into-geckoboard-using-google-sheets) , and[SQL queries](https://support.geckoboard.com/en/articles/6055535-create-visualizations-from-sql-queries) stop at 15 seconds and 4MB of results.
- **No in-product AI analysis.** Geckoboard’s AI feature is a read-only[Metrics MCP server](https://support.geckoboard.com/en/articles/15331363-getting-started-with-the-geckoboard-metrics-mcp) for Claude or ChatGPT that covers a list of SaaS sources, not databases. It has no AI summaries or anomaly detection inside the product.
- **Enterprise-only SSO.**[SAML SSO requires Enterprise](https://support.geckoboard.com/en/articles/6055686-sso-in-geckoboard) , and SCIM is not documented.


If none of those apply, Geckoboard is still a reasonable choice. The alternatives below each fix one or more of them.


## How we evaluated Geckoboard alternatives


We scored each tool against the questions buyers ask when they replace a KPI wallboard:


1. **TV display.** Can the tool pair a screen, rotate dashboards, and stay signed in without a person at the keyboard?
2. **Refresh speed.** What is the fastest documented data refresh, and on which plan?
3. **Alerts.** Can the tool push threshold or anomaly alerts to Slack, Teams, or email, and on which plan?
4. **Data reach.** Does it connect natively to SaaS apps, SQL databases, and warehouses such as Snowflake and BigQuery?
5. **Security.** Is SAML SSO included or an add-on, is SCIM documented, and can different viewers see different rows?
6. **AI.** Does the tool answer plain-English questions, explain changes, or detect anomalies, and what does that cost?

## Geckoboard (the baseline)


**Best for:** small teams that want a few live KPIs on a TV and in Slack with almost no setup.


**Fact card: Geckoboard**


- **Pricing (as of October 2026):** Essentials from $79 per month billed annually or $99 monthly (2 dashboards, 1 editor, 1 screen); Performance from $319 per month annually or $399 monthly (20 dashboards, 3 editors, 5 screens); Enterprise by quote ([pricing](https://www.geckoboard.com/pricing/) ). Viewers are unlimited on every plan.
- **Free tier or trial:**[14-day trial](https://support.geckoboard.com/en/articles/6055692-try-geckoboard-for-14-days) ; no free plan.
- **Deployment:** software-as-a-service only.
- **Query model:** each connector refreshes on its own[schedule](https://support.geckoboard.com/en/articles/6055564-refresh-rates-for-data-sources-and-widgets) ; SQL queries refresh every 3 minutes to 12 hours, 10 minutes by default. A Datasets API accepts pushed data on every plan.
- **TV display:**[Send to screen](https://support.geckoboard.com/en/articles/6055746-use-send-to-screen-to-display-your-dashboards) pairs a TV through a passcode at gbrd.tv, and Loops rotate dashboards on a timer. Geckoboard says smart TV browsers are not reliable and recommends a separate device.
- **Security:** dashboard-level access only, with no documented row-level controls; SAML SSO on Enterprise; IP restrictions on every plan.
- **Not ideal for:** teams that need to explain why a number moved, query BigQuery directly, or get alerts on the entry plan.


## Databox


**Best for:** marketing, sales, and agency teams that want KPI dashboards from SaaS apps with AI summaries and anomaly alerts at a low entry price.


Databox is the most direct Geckoboard replacement. It covers the same SaaS apps, adds a free plan, and ships AI features Geckoboard lacks. The catch is that TV streaming, sharing, embeds, and alerts all start on the Team plans, so a like-for-like replacement for a Geckoboard wallboard costs $199 per month on annual billing.


**Fact card: Databox**


- **Pricing (as of October 2026):** Free $0 (1 user, 3 data sources, daily sync); Analyst $71 per month billed annually or $89 monthly (1 user, 5 sources); Team Core $199 or $249 (3 users, 10 sources); Team Scale $319 or $399 (10 users, 30 sources). Databox[does not charge per seat](https://databox.com/pricing) .
- **Free tier or trial:** free plan, plus a 14-day trial of any plan with no payment details.
- **Query model:** synced data. Paid plans sync[up to hourly](https://databox.com/pricing) , and a 15-minute sync costs $14 per month per source where the source supports it.
- **Data sources:** 130+ integrations, plus[warehouses and databases](https://help.databox.com/integrations) including BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, MySQL, PostgreSQL, and SQL Server on Analyst and up.
- **TV display:**[Stream to TV](https://help.databox.com/share-a-dashboard) through a code at tv.databox.com, on Team plans and up.
- **Alerts:** threshold alerts by email, mobile, or Slack, and[Smart Alerts](https://help.databox.com/set-up-a-metric-notification) that use anomaly detection.
- **Security:**[SAML SSO](https://help.databox.com/set-up-single-sign-on-sso) through the $40 per month advanced security add-on; SCIM provisioning is not supported. No row-level security is documented.
- **AI features:** the Genie AI analyst, performance summaries, and anomaly detection on every plan; an MCP server for ChatGPT or Claude from Analyst up. Usage draws on monthly AI credits that do not roll over.
- **Not ideal for:** teams that need minute-level refresh, live warehouse queries, or SCIM.


For a deeper head-to-head, see our[Databox alternatives comparison](https://www.basedash.com/vs/databox-alternatives) .


## Plecto


**Best for:** sales, contact center, and support teams that want real-time leaderboards on office TVs with gamification.


Plecto is built for the same wall screens Geckoboard targets, but it leans into individual performance: contests, achievements, and notifications that play on the slideshow, flash a Philips Hue light, or play a sound on Sonos. Pricing is per tracked employee, not per dashboard.


**Fact card: Plecto**


- **Pricing (as of October 2026):** Medium $24 and Large $37.20 per tracked license per month billed annually, or $30 and $46.50 monthly, with a 10-license minimum; Enterprise by quote ([pricing](https://www.plecto.com/pricing/) ). Every plan includes unlimited dashboards and data sources.
- **Free tier or trial:** 14-day trial.
- **Deployment:** cloud only, hosted in Europe.
- **Query model:** the[SQL integration](https://www.plecto.com/documentation/data-sources-integrations-api/integrations/integration-guides/sql/) polls from every minute to once a day and slows itself down for long imports.[Streaming metrics](https://www.plecto.com/documentation/data-sources-integrations-api/integrations/streaming-metrics/) push call data by webhook from Aircall, Talkdesk, Dixa, Zendesk, and a few other systems. A REST API accepts pushed data.
- **Data sources:** 140+ integrations; SQL integrations for MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle, Snowflake, BigQuery, Athena, and Redshift are on the Large plan.
- **TV display:**[native TV apps](https://www.plecto.com/documentation/slideshows/plecto-tv-app/) for LG, Samsung, and Android smart TVs, or a browser at tv.plecto.com with a four-digit code.
- **Alerts:**[notifications](https://www.plecto.com/documentation/notifications-gamification/notifications/how-notifications-work/) to the slideshow, mobile push, Slack, Teams, and email.
- **Security:** SAML SSO on every plan; SCIM not documented.[Dynamic dashboards](https://www.plecto.com/documentation/dashboards-reports/dashboards/dynamic-dashboards/) let employees see only their own or their team’s numbers, as an add-on.
- **AI features:** an AI formula assistant (beta) and an[MCP server](https://www.plecto.com/documentation/using-mcp-with-plecto/) that builds dashboards, formulas, and widgets from a description.
- **Not ideal for:** finance or product analysis, or teams under 10 people who would pay for unused licenses.


## Klipfolio PowerMetrics


**Best for:** teams that want a governed metric catalog with goals and forecasts, sourced from a warehouse or a dbt semantic layer.


Klipfolio sells two products. PowerMetrics is the newer, metric-centric one. Klips, the classic dashboard product, is still sold and is the closer match to Geckoboard: it has a built-in[Full Screen (TV) mode](https://support.klipfolio.com/hc/en-us/articles/216183607) with a dashboard slideshow and[plans](https://www.klipfolio.com/pricing) from $120 per month billed annually for 3 dashboards and unlimited users, with 15-minute refresh and SSO on the $310 Team plan.


**Fact card: Klipfolio PowerMetrics**


- **Pricing (as of October 2026):** Launch $24 per user per month billed annually or $30 monthly, 2-user minimum, 50 metrics; Professional $35 or $45, 3-user minimum, 200 metrics; Custom by quote ([pricing](https://www.powermetrics.app/pricing) ).
- **Free tier or trial:** 30-day trial; no free plan.
- **Query model:** data feeds refresh every 4 hours on Launch and every hour on Professional; a 15-minute refresh is a $180 per month add-on. Direct warehouse metrics cover Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, PostgreSQL, MariaDB, Redshift, Aurora, Azure SQL, and Azure Synapse. The pricing table marks warehouse queries as included on Professional but also lists them as a $180 add-on, so confirm with sales.
- **TV display:**[published views](https://support.powermetrics.app/hc/en-us/articles/37726229053975-How-do-I-share-dashboards-as-published-views) on Professional can run on large TVs at 1080p or 4K. Rotating several dashboards needs a third-party browser extension.
- **Alerts:**[goal notifications](https://support.powermetrics.app/hc/en-us/articles/37726232850071) in-app and by email; Slack delivery is not documented.
- **Security:** SAML SSO as a $69 per month add-on or on Custom; SCIM and row-level security not documented.
- **AI features:** an AI Assistant (beta) on every plan; an MCP server and metrics API on Professional; forecasts and outlier ranges on Professional or as a $45 add-on.
- **Not ideal for:** a TV wallboard on a budget, where Klips or Geckoboard fits better.


## Metabase


**Best for:** teams with their own database that want a free or low-cost dashboard on an office TV, with alerts and the option to self-host.


Metabase queries the database live, so a dashboard on a TV is only as stale as its refresh setting. The[dashboard docs](https://www.metabase.com/docs/latest/dashboards/introduction) describe putting a dashboard on a TV: add` #refresh=60&fullscreen` to the URL and it refreshes every 60 seconds in fullscreen. You still need a device that stays signed in.


**Fact card: Metabase**


- **Pricing (as of October 2026):** Open Source free; Starter $100 per month with 5 users, then $6 per user; Pro $575 per month with 10 users, then $12 per user; Enterprise from $20,000 per year ([pricing](https://www.metabase.com/pricing/) ).
- **Free tier or trial:** free self-hosted open source edition under the AGPL; 14-day trial of paid plans.
- **Deployment:** Metabase Cloud or self-hosted with Docker.
- **Query model:** live queries against 18+[official drivers](https://www.metabase.com/docs/latest/databases/connecting) , including PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, ClickHouse, and Databricks; dashboard caching on Pro and Enterprise. Metabase does not connect to SaaS apps directly.
- **Alerts:**[question alerts](https://www.metabase.com/docs/latest/questions/alerts) fire when a time series crosses a goal line or a progress bar reaches its goal, checked as often as every minute, and go to email, Slack, or a webhook. Dashboard subscriptions reach people without accounts.
- **Security:**[row and column security](https://www.metabase.com/docs/latest/permissions/row-and-column-security) , SAML and JWT SSO, and[SCIM](https://www.metabase.com/docs/latest/people-and-groups/user-provisioning) on Pro and Enterprise.
- **AI features:**[Metabot](https://www.metabase.com/docs/latest/ai/metabot) builds charts from natural language, writes and fixes SQL, and answers questions in Slack on every plan; an MCP server on every plan.
- **Not ideal for:** teams whose KPIs live in SaaS apps with no database behind them, or teams that need row-level security on the $100 Starter plan.


## Grafana Cloud


**Best for:** engineering and operations teams that want second-level refresh, kiosk playlists, and alert routing on database metrics.


Grafana started as an observability tool, but its SQL data sources,[kiosk mode](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest/dashboards/use-dashboards/) , and[playlists](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest/dashboards/create-manage-playlists/) make it a common free Geckoboard alternative for engineering-led companies. Business users usually find it harder to build in than Geckoboard.


**Fact card: Grafana Cloud**


- **Pricing (as of October 2026):** Free with 3 active users; Pro from a $19 monthly platform fee that includes 3 active users, then from $8 per active user; Enterprise from a $25,000 annual commit ([pricing](https://grafana.com/pricing/) ). An active user is anyone who signs in during the month.
- **Free tier or trial:** free tier; open source Grafana is self-hostable under the AGPLv3.
- **Query model:** live queries with dashboard auto-refresh intervals measured in seconds. PostgreSQL, MySQL, and SQL Server are[built in](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest/datasources/) , BigQuery is a Grafana Labs plugin, and[Snowflake](https://grafana.com/docs/plugins/grafana-snowflake-datasource/latest/) is an Enterprise plugin, which on Cloud Pro costs $55 per active user per month instead of $8.
- **Alerts:**[contact points](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest/alerting/configure-notifications/manage-contact-points/) include Slack, Microsoft Teams, email, PagerDuty, and webhooks.
- **Security:**[SAML](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest/setup-grafana/configure-access/configure-authentication/saml/) on Grafana Cloud paid plans and Enterprise;[SCIM](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest/setup-grafana/configure-access/configure-scim-provisioning/) works alongside SAML. Data source permissions restrict access by user or team, but SQL row-level security is not documented.
- **AI features:**[Grafana Assistant](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/machine-learning/assistant/) helps build dashboards and query data sources, including PostgreSQL, BigQuery, and Snowflake, at $20 per active AI user on Pro.
- **Not ideal for:** non-technical teams that want SaaS-app KPIs without writing queries.


## Google Data Studio (formerly Looker Studio)


**Best for:** teams whose KPIs live in Google Sheets, GA4, Google Ads, or BigQuery and who want a free starting point.


Google renamed Looker Studio[back to Data Studio](https://docs.cloud.google.com/data-studio/welcome) in April 2026. The free version can loop report pages full screen in[present mode](https://docs.cloud.google.com/data-studio/present-a-report) , but report[auto-refresh](https://docs.cloud.google.com/data-studio/manage-auto-refresh-for-a-report) and alerts are Pro features.


**Fact card: Google Data Studio**


- **Pricing (as of October 2026):** free for creators and viewers; Data Studio Pro $9 per user per project per month ([pricing](https://cloud.google.com/looker-studio) ). Viewers of Pro content do not need a Pro license.
- **Free tier or trial:** free; 30-day Pro trial.
- **Query model:** live queries with a[freshness cache](https://docs.cloud.google.com/data-studio/manage-data-freshness) . Database connectors refresh every 1 minute to 12 hours (12 hours by default), Google Sheets every 15 minutes by default, and Google Ads and other marketing sources every 12 hours, fixed. Google builds connectors for BigQuery, PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, and Redshift; Snowflake needs a partner connector.
- **TV display:** present mode loops pages full screen on any plan; report auto-refresh every 5 minutes or more on Pro.
- **Alerts:**[chart alerts](https://docs.cloud.google.com/data-studio/create-alerts-on-a-chart) on Pro only, by email to people in your organization; Slack delivery of scheduled reports is also Pro only.
- **Security:** row-level security through[filter by email address](https://docs.cloud.google.com/data-studio/filter-by-email-address) ; Google account sign-in, with SAML and SCIM not documented.
- **AI features:**[conversational analytics](https://docs.cloud.google.com/data-studio/conversational-analytics-overview) for all users on BigQuery data agents; Gemini features on Pro.
- **Not ideal for:** Snowflake or SaaS-app KPIs outside Google, or alerting to Slack.


## Microsoft Power BI


**Best for:** Microsoft 365 companies that already pay for Power BI Pro and want KPI tiles with email alerts.


Power BI is a full BI platform, not a wallboard. Microsoft documents[full screen mode](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-bi/explore-reports/end-user-report-view) for kiosk displays, but there is no TV app, and the most frequent[automatic page refresh](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-bi/create-reports/desktop-automatic-page-refresh) on a Pro license is every 30 minutes, for DirectQuery sources only.


**Fact card: Microsoft Power BI**


- **Pricing (as of October 2026):** Pro $14 and Premium Per User $24 per user per month, paid yearly ([pricing](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/products/power-bi/pricing) ). Viewers need a paid license unless content sits on F64 or P1 capacity and above.
- **Free tier or trial:** free account for personal use.
- **Deployment:** Power BI service, or Power BI Report Server on-premises.
- **Query model:** imported models refresh[8 times a day on Pro and 48 on PPU](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-bi/connect-data/refresh-data) ; DirectQuery pages can refresh every 30 minutes on Pro and as often as every second on Premium or Fabric capacity, where the capacity admin’s default floor is 5 minutes. Creation of push and streaming semantic models ends on[October 31, 2027](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-bi/connect-data/service-real-time-streaming) , with Fabric Real-Time Intelligence as the replacement.
- **Alerts:**[data alerts](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-bi/create-reports/service-set-data-alerts) on card, KPI, and gauge tiles, checked at most hourly, by email; Fabric Activator sends Teams messages on Fabric capacity.
- **Security:**[row-level security](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/fabric/security/service-admin-row-level-security) roles that apply to Viewers only; Microsoft Entra ID sign-in.
- **AI features:**[Copilot](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-bi/create-reports/copilot-introduction) needs paid Fabric F2 or Premium P1 capacity; a Pro license alone is not enough.
- **Not ideal for:** a wallboard that has to refresh every few minutes on a Pro license.


## Basedash


**Best for:** teams with data in a database or warehouse that want an AI data analyst to build KPI dashboards from a prompt and watch the numbers for them.


Basedash is not a TV wallboard. It has no TV pairing or slideshow mode, so a screen needs a signed-in browser. It fits teams that replace Geckoboard because they want to ask why a KPI moved, not just display it: the[AI data analyst](https://www.basedash.com/features/ai-data-analyst) answers questions in plain English against the connected database, and dashboards can be generated from a description and refined in chat.


**Fact card: Basedash**


- **Pricing (as of October 2026):** Startup $1,000 per month plus AI usage, with up to 25 users and $1,000 of monthly AI credits; Enterprise custom ([pricing](https://www.basedash.com/pricing) ). Monthly and annual billing.
- **Free tier or trial:** 14-day trial with no credit card.
- **Deployment:** cloud;[self-hosting](https://www.basedash.com/features/self-hosting) on Enterprise.
- **Query model:** live SQL against PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, ClickHouse, Databricks, and other native connections. SaaS apps such as HubSpot, Stripe, and Salesforce sync into the[Basedash Warehouse](https://www.basedash.com/features/warehouse) .[Dashboards](https://www.basedash.com/docs/features/dashboards) auto-refresh every 15 minutes by default, and the interval is adjustable.
- **Alerts:**[automations](https://www.basedash.com/docs/features/automations) can run when a SQL query detects new or changed data and send an AI-written update by email or Slack;[Insights](https://www.basedash.com/features/insights) flag notable changes on their own. Dashboard subscriptions send scheduled snapshots to email or Slack.
- **Security:** dashboard permissions by member or group;[row-level security](https://www.basedash.com/docs/features/row-level-security) for Postgres only; SSO and SCIM on Enterprise.
- **AI features:** chat-based analysis, AI dashboard generation, Insights, a[Slack app](https://www.basedash.com/docs/features/slack) , and an[MCP server](https://www.basedash.com/features/mcp-server) on every plan.
- **Not ideal for:** office TV wallboards, gamified sales leaderboards, or teams that want a dashboard tool under $100 a month.


## Which Geckoboard alternative should you choose?


**If you mainly need KPIs on an office TV:** Plecto has native TV apps and the deepest wallboard features. Klipfolio Klips has a built-in TV slideshow from $120 per month. Databox streams to TVs on its Team plans. Metabase and Grafana work well on a TV if someone can keep a browser signed in.


**If you need refresh every minute and alerts in Slack:** Plecto polls SQL every minute and posts to Slack and Teams. Grafana refreshes in seconds and routes alerts to Slack, Teams, and PagerDuty. Metabase checks goal-line alerts as often as every minute. Databox tops out at 15 minutes with a paid add-on, and Power BI at 30 minutes on Pro.


**If your KPIs live in SaaS apps like HubSpot, Stripe, and Shopify:** Databox is the closest swap for Geckoboard, with a free plan and more integrations. Plecto covers sales and support tools. Basedash syncs SaaS apps into its own warehouse alongside database data.


**If your KPIs live in Snowflake or BigQuery:** Metabase, Grafana (with the BigQuery plugin or the Snowflake Enterprise plugin), Basedash, and PowerMetrics query warehouses directly. Data Studio covers BigQuery natively and Snowflake through partners.


**If you need SSO or SCIM without an enterprise contract:** Plecto includes SAML on every plan, Databox sells it as a $40 add-on, PowerMetrics as a $69 add-on, and Metabase includes SAML and SCIM on Pro. Grafana Cloud documents SAML on paid plans, with SCIM provisioning that works only alongside SAML.


**If you want AI to explain what changed:** Databox includes anomaly detection and AI summaries on every plan, Metabase includes Metabot, and Basedash runs data-change automations and Insights on top of an AI data analyst. Our[AI anomaly detection comparison](https://www.basedash.com/blog/best-bi-tools-for-ai-anomaly-detection-and-smart-alerting-2026) covers that use case in more depth.


**If budget is the main constraint:** Data Studio is free, Grafana Cloud’s free tier covers 3 users, and open source Metabase and Grafana cost only hosting.


## Frequently asked questions


### What is the best alternative to Geckoboard?


For most teams it is Databox, because it connects to the same SaaS apps, has a free plan, and adds anomaly alerts and an AI analyst that Geckoboard does not have. Databox Team plans, from $199 per month billed annually, include TV streaming, sharing, and alerts. Sales and support teams that want gamified leaderboards on office TVs should look at Plecto instead, and teams with their own database should look at Metabase or Grafana. Prices were checked in October 2026.


### Geckoboard vs Databox: which is better for KPI dashboards?


Geckoboard is simpler for TV wallboards. Every plan includes screens and unlimited viewers, and SQL queries refresh every 3 minutes. Databox is broader. It has a free plan, 130+ integrations, native BigQuery, and AI summaries and anomaly detection on every plan, but paid plans sync hourly unless you buy a $14 per month 15-minute add-on for each source. Geckoboard alerts start at $319 per month and Databox alerts at $199 per month, both billed annually.


### Which KPI dashboard software can refresh every minute and push alerts to Slack?


Plecto’s SQL integration can update every minute and send notifications to Slack, Microsoft Teams, and email. Grafana dashboards refresh in seconds, and its alerting sends to Slack, Teams, email, and PagerDuty. Metabase queries databases live, can auto-refresh a fullscreen dashboard every 60 seconds, and can check goal-line alerts every minute. Geckoboard’s fastest SQL refresh is 3 minutes, with Slack alerts on Performance. Databox, Power BI, and Data Studio refresh less often.


### What is the best TV dashboard software for an office?


Plecto has native TV apps for LG, Samsung, and Android smart TVs, and pairs screens with a four-digit code. Geckoboard and Databox pair a TV browser through a short code and manage screens remotely. Klipfolio Klips has a Full Screen (TV) mode with a dashboard slideshow. Grafana uses kiosk mode with playlists, and Metabase uses a fullscreen URL with auto-refresh. Geckoboard says smart TV browsers are unreliable and Klipfolio does not support them, so plan on a small streaming device or computer.


### Is there a free alternative to Geckoboard?


Yes. Google Data Studio is free and can loop report pages full screen, though auto-refresh and alerts need Pro at $9 per user per project per month. Grafana Cloud’s free tier covers 3 active users, and open source Grafana and Metabase are free to self-host. Databox has a free plan with 1 user, 3 data sources, and daily sync, but TV streaming needs a Team plan. Geckoboard itself has a 14-day trial and no free plan.


### Which Geckoboard alternatives connect to Snowflake or BigQuery?


Metabase, Basedash, Databox, Plecto, and Klipfolio PowerMetrics connect to both Snowflake and BigQuery. In Plecto, SQL integrations need the Large plan. Grafana has a BigQuery plugin and a Snowflake plugin that is an Enterprise plugin, at $55 per active user per month on Cloud Pro. Data Studio connects to BigQuery natively and to Snowflake through partner connectors. Geckoboard connects to Snowflake but reaches BigQuery only through Google Sheets.


### Which KPI dashboard tools let each person see only their own numbers?


Plecto’s dynamic dashboards, an add-on, show each employee their own or their team’s data. Metabase Pro and Enterprise include row and column security, Power BI uses row-level security roles for Viewers, and Data Studio filters by the viewer’s email address. Basedash supports row-level security on Postgres databases. Geckoboard, Databox, and Klipfolio PowerMetrics control access per dashboard, with no row-level security documented.
